title: Quick Jellified American Bake
description: A crispy, resinous meal-prep dish that's perfect for a weeknight dinner, featuring cream of tartar for added texture.

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup chopped pecans (optional)
ingredients.notes: adds nice crunch to the top

instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and cream of tartar.
In a separate large bowl, whisk together the melted butter, eggs, vanilla extract, and milk.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir until just combined.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Bake for 25 minutes, then reduce the heat to 350°F (180°C) and continue baking for an additional 15 minutes.
If using pecans, sprinkle them evenly over the top of the bake and return to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Remove the bake from the oven and let it cool completely on a wire rack.
Once cooled, refrigerate the bake for at least 30 minutes to set the jellified texture.
Cut into squares and serve chilled.
